name: Verdia Gensoukyoku
source:
The main character is a musical instrument tuner, who just comes back to his hometown for the first time in ten years. The city is vibrant with life, preparing for a big festival. One day, he loses his consciousness due to hunger and tiredness and is saved by Fina. Fina has a special power that she can call musical instruments. At the festival, there is a music contest and he decides to take part in it with her....

translation:
主人公是一名乐器调音师，时隔十年首次回到故乡。城市里生机勃勃，人们正为一场盛大节日作准备。某天，他因饥饿和疲劳失去意识，被菲娜救下。菲娜拥有召唤乐器的特殊能力。节日期间将举办音乐比赛，他决定与她一同参赛……
